enchantments.tooltip: Legendary Nightmare Guard: On being hit or missed, this item has a chance to attempt to fear your enemy, ripping the life from them as if they were struck with a Phantasmal Killer spell. Enemies must make a DC 100 Will save versus the Fear or a DC 100 Fortitude save versus Death or be slain. Even if they make their save versus Death, they may still be feared.
Charisma +14: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Spell Focus Mastery +7: +7 Equipment bonus to the DC of all spells.
Insightful Spell Focus Mastery +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of all spells.

Echoes of the Walking Ancestors: 3 Pieces Equipped:+3 Artifact bonus to all Spell DCs+3 Artifact bonus to all Tactical DCs and Assassinate+3 Artifact bonus to all Ability Scores+3 Artifact bonus to Imbue Dice
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
